topic: Weather conditions and changes over time
key_concepts: Maaraw means sunny weather with strong sunlight
Mahangin means windy weather with strong wind
Maulan means rainy weather with dark clouds and falling rain
Maulap means cloudy weather with a sky full of clouds and dim light
Mabagyo means stormy weather that can be dangerous and cancel classes
Windy weather is good for flying kites
Weather conditions can be observed and recorded over a week
Weather changes from day to day
Different weather types have different observable sky, wind, and rain features
